thread:
Asha: EOD check-in — quick summary. Current incident: embed-evictions in eu-west1 causing higher tail latency. Mitigations applied: bumped kvcache eviction threshold, increased dedup worker pool, and temporarily routed regen to fallback model-v2 for low-priority traffic. Monitoring p99 for /v1/regen.

Miguel: Copy. Canary deploy finished 03:30 UTC, no errors in logs. I pushed hotfix (rollback-window 5m -> 15m) and rolled out to 2/3 of pods. Pinged PR #4321 for review @Priya.

Priya: Saw the ping, will review in ~10m. Noted increased memory allocs on runtime-3 in traces, opened ticket #4330. Logging flag set to debug for 30m to capture stack.

Jon: Observed tokenization error spike 03:12-03:18 UTC (mostly short inputs). Muted noisy alert, annotated runbook with repro snippet. If it recurs, revert tokenizer to v1.2.0.

OpsBot: Deploy status: commit abc123 -> prod, 03/17 03:30 UTC. canary: 4/4 checks passed.

Asha: Thanks. Blockers: PR reviews and the runtime memory trace analysis. Next steps: 1) Watch p99 regen for next 30m, 2) ensure embed eviction rate <5% for eu-west1, 3) confirm autoscaler not thrashing (kubectl top nodes / look at hpa events). If latency stays stable for 20m we de-escalate.

Miguel: Taking overnight. Pager is on. I'll run a short reindex job at 04:15 UTC (low traffic window) to reduce evictions. Will escalate to SRE if evictions >8% after job.

Priya: :thumbsup: Will land PR after CI finishes, leaving notes in the PR about the memory traces.

Jon: Quick tip — if tokenization errors spike again, revert tokenizer model to `v1.2.0` and re-run the failing corpus locally: `python tools/tokenize_check.py --sample 1000`.

Asha: Thanks all. Handoff: Miguel (overnight), Priya (PR & memory), Jon (tokenization). I'll check in before midnight my time. If anything urgent, page me or @miguel.

Miguel: Acknowledged. Leaving a short runbook entry in the channel with commands: ```
# quick checks
kubectl get hpa -n inference
kubectl top pods -n inference
curl -s https://metrics.internal/p99?route=/v1/regen
```

Priya: Noted, will follow up on #4330 results.

Jon: I'll keep an eye on tokenization alerts. If anyone needs the repro set, ping me.

Asha: Okay wrapping up — thanks team.
